title: BreachTermsPackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly breach-terms (INV-REQ-1385): the assessment and notification terms of a suspected personal data breach, whole hours each. The terms are an operator-maintained regulatory-pack datum, so tenants cannot alter them. The schema carries no default and no maximum: a figure here would be an invented legal value. A consumer ignores any property this schema does not name (API-41); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. Within a major version this schema is additive-only.

assessmentWithinHours.description: The time, in whole hours, within which a suspected personal data breach is assessed.

notificationWithinHours.description: The time, in whole hours, within which a notifiable breach is notified, counted from the instant it is assessed notifiable.

sourceReference.description: The counsel confirmation the values rest on.
